user.title: Intelbras alarm panel
user.description: Enter the panel MAC address and the remote password (the same one used in the AMT Mobile app). The MAC is shown in the app under Edit panel or on the Ethernet module label.

reauth_confirm.title: Panel password
reauth_confirm.description: Panel {mac} rejected the password. Enter the current remote password.

error.invalid_auth: Remote password rejected by the panel
error.panel_offline: The panel is not connected to the Intelbras cloud
error.panel_busy: Another device is connected to the panel right now. Close the phone app and try again
error.wrong_model: The panel response does not match the selected model
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Intelbras cloud
